# Probe manifest

The spec-phase **probe family** — one row per axis, rendered from the live `PROBE_REGISTRY` (ADR-20).
Each taxonomy entry is a **question this probe can raise**, not a guarantee of what it catches: the
classifier is a signal, and the human/LLM confirm step is what makes coverage sound.

| Axis | Title | Propose | Verification tiers | Relevance vocabulary |
|------|-------|---------|--------------------|----------------------|
| `edge` | Spec-completeness edge probe | deterministic | `explicit` \| `backstop` | data/behavior shape: numeric-range, collection, text, stateful, io |
| `prohibition` | Prohibition (must-NOT) probe | llm-recall | `test` \| `judgment` | — (open-vocabulary) |
| `ui` | UI-consideration probe | deterministic | `explicit` \| `backstop` | UI element kind: form, list-collection, nav, media, interactive-control, static-content |

## `edge` — Spec-completeness edge probe

- **Invoke:** `edge-probe.cjs`
- **Propose:** deterministic
- **Verification tiers:** `explicit`, `backstop`

| Category | Applies to | Question this probe can raise |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------|
| `boundary` | numeric-range | What happens exactly at each min/max/threshold — and one step either side? |
| `adjacency` | collection | When two things are exactly equal or just touch, do they merge, collide, or separate? |
| `empty` | collection, text | What is the result for empty, single-element, or null input? |
| `encoding` | text | Whose definition of length/equality applies — bytes, code points, grapheme clusters, or normalized form? |
| `ordering` | collection | When elements compare equal, is output order specified and stable? |
| `precision` | numeric-range | Where can precision loss, overflow, or rounding/tie-breaking occur — and what is the exact contract (e.g. half-up vs half-to-even, ceil/floor/truncate)? |
| `idempotency` | stateful | What happens if this runs twice on the same input? |
| `concurrency` | stateful, io | If interrupted or run in parallel, what is guaranteed? |

## `prohibition` — Prohibition (must-NOT) probe

- **Invoke:** `gsd_run check prohibition-enforcement`
- **Propose:** llm-recall (LLM adversarial recall — no closed taxonomy)
- **Verification tiers:** `test`, `judgment`

_Open-vocabulary probe — no closed category taxonomy; recall enumerates the constraints at runtime._

## `ui` — UI-consideration probe

- **Invoke:** `ui-consideration-probe.cjs`
- **Propose:** deterministic
- **Verification tiers:** `explicit`, `backstop`

| Category | Applies to | Question this probe can raise |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------|
| `empty` | form, list-collection, media | What is shown when there is no data — zero items, an unfilled form, or absent media? |
| `loading` | form, list-collection, media, nav | What is shown while data or content is still loading (skeleton, spinner, progressive reveal)? |
| `error` | form, list-collection, media, nav | What is shown when the load or submit fails (message, retry affordance, partial fallback)? |
| `populated` | list-collection, media | What does the normal populated (happy-path) state look like at a typical volume of content? |
| `partial` | form, list-collection | What is shown for partial or incomplete data — some fields or rows present, others missing? |
| `overflow` | list-collection, nav, static-content | What happens when content exceeds its container — scroll, clip, wrap, or truncate? |
| `zero-one-many` | list-collection | How does the layout read at zero, one, and many items (singular vs plural copy, spacing)? |
| `long-text` | form, static-content, interactive-control, nav | What happens with unusually long text — truncation, wrapping, ellipsis, or reflow? |
